dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Great! Still, you might need to pick quite a few...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Let me see... First, please help me pick one sweet flower and one small lamp grass from the Whispering Woods.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Then go to Windrise, and get me one windwheel aster.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Finally, help me pick a Cecilia from Starsnatch Cliff.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Please come back as soon as possible once you have them. If they wilt, they can't be displayed at the storefront.
